titleNative: 先生日誌 ほむら先生はたぶんモテない
synopsis: Homura-sensei is the frail biology teacher in his track-suit and white lab coat. Hasumi-san is a new home economics teacher, returning to her alma mater to be with him. Their social positions may have changed, but their feelings remain the same. The sweet, awkward romance between them continues, in this new series depicting their love story as adults! (Source: Pixiv Comics, translated) Note: Sekaneko started publishing this manga on her blog on September 14, 2021. On September 2022, the manga got licensed by Kadokawa.

title: Yane no Shita no Artemis
titleNative: 屋根の下のアルテミス
synopsis: A prodigy of science and a solitary genius—yet terrible at so many things!? When the poor university student Sanosuke Saraki started at a new part-time job at his old high school, he unexpectedly reunites with Koharu Kobachi, a classmate that he admired as a brilliant genius. However, this supposed genius is now a "5th year high school student" who must repeat her senior year for the second time…! Saraki's mission is to "help Koharu graduate by the end of the year." A coming-of-age story about starting over with a 20-year-old high school student!

synopsis: This world is filthy… Nakayama, a high school boy with an extreme case of germophobia, avoids all social interaction and tries to enjoy his private time alone in a perfectly clean space. synopsis: The story begins when Azuma Akari, a young man with an ambition to be a chef, trips into another world. Akari is picked up by Gangreve, the leader of a mercenary group. Akari joins the group as an odd job and gradually increases hia own value by demonstrating hia cooking skills. Each leader of the mercenary group is a quirky character, but Akari connects with them through his cooking. By improving the mercenary group's food situation and occasionally helping with inventions, Akari is gradually recognized by his fellow members of the mercenary group. However, Akari does not yet know that he himself will become a hero.

title: Battlefront of the Great Powers
synopsis: In the year 2206, planet Earth is on the brink of destruction. Due to pollution and a shortage of resources, scientists estimate that the planet will become unable to sustain life within the next hundred years. To resolve the issue of scarcity, the world's leaders have come together and decided on a desperate solution-the National Extinction Tournament. Gathering those with powers beyond human comprehension, these boys and girls will compete for the sake of their nations...and their own survival! Win and become a hero. Lose and death awaits not only you but everyone you love... (Source: Yen Press)
